prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Move the camera from beside this red tractor into its cab, viewing through the open right-hand door at seat height, looking diagonally toward the front windshield. Create a clean empty interior plate. The main dark padded driver's seat is on the LEFT behind the black steering wheel; on the RIGHT is a small properly mounted passenger seat with a cushion and visible lap belt, sized for a little hedgehog. Simple sturdy real tractor interior: rubber floor, red painted door frame, clear windshield, modest dashboard, steering column, two crane-control joysticks beside the main seat, no readable labels. Leave clear seating space for a beaver driver and a much smaller hedgehog passenger to be added later. Through the windshield see the same green sunlit fern-lined forest track and a little red hood below it. Frame both seats fully, close and welcoming, with natural soft reflected light and detailed textured highlights matching the reference's dimensional children's-book style. review: Clean interior accepted: left driver seat/right smaller passenger seat, steering wheel, controls and belts are legible; no animals. Soft textured interior and forest match the machine.
